messages.subject: Google Crawl Shiny site
parts:

  • When I use an index checker, it says the site is not indexed and crawlers and disallowed.
  • Started linking the site in various locations within other websites
  • In dashboardBody() I have included the following html file (slightly modified here for easy of the example)-> 
<html>
<head>
<title>MY WEBSITE'S NAME</title>
<meta name="description" content="This is the website.">

Kind Regards and thanks in advance for all of your help,
